description: Implementation of ContentDao interface providing data access methods for Content entities, including listing, retrieval by code, ID, language, and URL, utilizing QueryDSL for JPQL queries within a Spring repository context.

classes.name: ContentDaoImpl
classes.description: Provides database access functionality for Content entities, implementing ContentDao, extending a generic DAO, and utilizing QueryDSL for constructing JPQL queries.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered by ContentType, MerchantStore, and optionally Language, ordered by sortOrder.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Returns a list of ContentDescription objects containing names and URLs for content filtered by ContentType, MerchantStore, and Language, only including visible content.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a single Content entity matching the specified code and MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves Content by its ID and associated Language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves Content entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches Content by code, MerchantStore, and Language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the ContentDescription for a given store and SEO URL if the content is visible.
